user.title: Connect to your WattBox
user.description: Enter the WattBox's local IP, the integration username, and password. The default username is `wattbox`.

data.transport: Transport (SSH preferred, Telnet works without SSH password setup)

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate your WattBox
reauth_confirm.description: WattBox at {host} rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current ones.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect — check the host/port and that the WattBox is on the network.
error.api_locked: The WattBox API is in a temporary lockout after repeated failed logins. Wait ~15 minutes or reboot the device.
error.unknown: Unexpected error setting up the WattBox.

abort.already_configured: This WattBox is already configured (matched by service tag).
